scenes.headline: Me at the party at 10:30 pm
Tigers really are solo acts
scenes.body: In the wild, adult tigers are thought to live alone except when mating or raising young. This tiger was being released back to the wild in Russia.

caption:
Introvert icon, scientifically.

Being solitary doesn't mean silent: communication is a very important part of tiger life, through scent marks, scrapes and calls.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo (Tiger).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: 'Me leaving' trend acted to an in-app sound, cut against a real CC release clip (crate, snarl, empty field) so the joke lands on solitary tiger behaviour.
